calls.body: SELECT TraceId, SpanId, ParentSpanId, SpanName, SpanKind, ServiceName, StatusCode, StatusMessage, Duration, SpanAttributes, ResourceAttributes, toUnixTimestamp64Nano(Timestamp) AS ts_ns, arrayMap(t -> toUnixTimestamp64Nano(t), Events.Timestamp) AS event_ts, Events.Name AS event_names, Events.Attributes AS event_attrs FROM `default`.`otel_traces` WHERE TraceId = '00000000000000000000000000000000' ORDER BY Timestamp
